_comment: Workday boards. Separate from ats_boards.json because a Workday board needs host/tenant/site rather than a single slug, and because this source runs on its own slower timer -- every posting costs a detail request, so it cannot ride the 6-hourly pass. See AGENTS.md.
_verified: All entries confirmed live 2026-10-24 by POSTing {tenant}/{site}/jobs and reading `total`. A wrong site slug returns 422 and a wrong tenant still returns 406 from the wildcard host, so a board MUST be confirmed by a 200 with a total -- do not add one on a guess.
_missing: AMD, Qualcomm, Lam Research, Dell and Analog Devices have Workday tenants but none of the site slugs tried worked. TSMC and MediaTek are NOT on Workday: TSMC 403s all automation including robots.txt, and MediaTek runs a bespoke Strapi site with no public API.
